own_solution.law: Helmholtz resonator: f = (c/2pi) sqrt(A/(V L_eff)), L_eff = l + 2*0.85 a

notes: Strata agree with my pass 1. Checked certified R answers: q=1.7 cm L_eff=0.0774 m f=107.76 Hz; q=3.2 cm L_eff=0.0924 m f=98.63 Hz; q=6.3 cm L_eff=0.1234 m f=85.34 Hz. Density cancellation correct. Minimal pairs TF909/TB582 (funnel stem vs flask neck, both 3.2 cm) and T19EB/TE665 (earlier run vs whole measurement, both 3.2 cm) differ only in attachment. My pass-1 medium rendering_not_minimal flag on TF775 and T8378 is withdrawn: the authors declare them numeral-free controls (twins of TF909 and T19EB) rather than minimal-pair variants, and their wording matches their twins with only the number replaced.
